items.title: 21.1 Luminosity of a star (sitare ki roshni ki kul power) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the luminosity of a star (PDF 170).

blocks.text: Luminosity (sitare ki kul roshni ki power) woh kul energy hai jo koi star har second electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein emit karta hai (bahar nikalta hai). Yeh star ki basic property (bunyadi khoobi) hai jo us ki asal (intrinsic) chamak batati hai. Luminosity ka symbol L hai aur yeh watts mein napi jati hai, yani yeh star se nikalne wali radiation ki kul power hai. Star ki luminosity zyada tar do cheezon par depend karti hai (munhasir hai): us ka radius aur us ki surface ka temperature. Bare stars ke paas radiation chhorne ke liye zyada surface area hota hai, is liye woh zyada luminous (roshan) hote hain. Isi tarah barabar size ke do stars mein se jis ki surface zyada garam ho, woh zyada energy emit karta hai aur us ki luminosity zyada hoti hai. Star ki luminosity ko us ke surface area (A = 4πr²) aur radiant intensity (har square metre se nikalne wali power, I = σT⁴) ke product (zarb, multiply) ki shakal mein likhte hain:

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Sooraj taqreeban 4×10²⁶ watts ki bohat bari luminosity se chamakta hai. Yeh itni energy hai jaise har second arbon nuclear dhamake ho rahe hon.
Equation (21.1) ko Stefan-Boltzmann law kehte hain. Yeh law kehta hai:

blocks.title: Stefan-Boltzmann law
blocks.text: Star ki kul output power us ke surface area aur us ke temperature ki fourth power (T⁴) ke product ke proportional hai (yani isi hisaab se barhti hai).

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Stefan-Boltzmann law ki madad se astronomers (sitaron ke scientists) sirf temperature jaan kar stars ka size aur chamak andaza laga lete hain.

Yahan σ Stefan-Boltzmann constant hai, jis ki value 5.67×10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ hai. T surface ka temperature (kelvin mein) aur r star ka radius hai. Yaad rakhein: T⁴ ki wajah se temperature thora sa barhe to luminosity bohat zyada barhti hai.

blocks.title: Example 21.1
blocks.problem: Aik star ki luminosity 2.5 × 10²⁶ W aur us ki surface ka temperature 6000 K hai. Star ka radius andaza lagayein.
steps: Diya gaya: luminosity L = 2.5 × 10²⁶ W, surface temperature T = 6000 K; maloom karna hai radius r = ?
Is ko r ke liye solve karein: r² = L/(4πσT⁴), is liye r = √(L/4πσT⁴)
(6000)⁴ = 1.296 × 10¹⁵, is liye neeche wala hissa 4 × 3.14 × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ × 1.296 × 10¹⁵ ≈ 9.23 × 10⁸ W m⁻² banta hai; 2.5 × 10²⁶ / 9.23 × 10⁸ ≈ 2.7 × 10¹⁷ m², aur is ka square root ≈ 5.2 × 10⁸ m
blocks.answer: r = 5.2 × 10⁸ m (yeh Sooraj ke radius, taqreeban 7 × 10⁸ m, se thora chhota hai)

blocks.prompt: Agar star (size wahi rehte hue) dugna garam ho jaye to woh kitne guna zyada energy emit karega?
blocks.explanation: L, T⁴ ke proportional hai. T dugna ho to L = 2⁴ = 16 guna ho jati hai.

items: Luminosity L: star se har second nikalne wali kul energy (power), watts mein.
Stefan-Boltzmann law: L = 4πr² σ T⁴ (21.1); σ = 5.67×10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴.
Bara radius ya zyada temperature: zyada luminosity; T dugna to L 16 guna.
